subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should this PR absorb the shared `packages/ai` recovery from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462, or be narrowed to provider-only cold-resume prevention while that PR owns generic recovery?
rationale: Both shapes can be made correct, but maintaining two independent retry implementations would create drift; a maintainer must select the canonical Responses recovery owner before merge.

options.title: Unify recovery here
options.body: Fold the bounded pre-output retry into the shared `packages/ai` Responses lifecycle, retain Copilot provider sanitation, and validate every consuming runner.

options.title: Narrow to prevention
options.body: Remove or explicitly defer the managed generic retry, land only Copilot cold-resume sanitation, and leave shared recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462.

recommendation.title: Unify recovery here
recommendation.body: Fold the bounded pre-output retry into the shared `packages/ai` Responses lifecycle, retain Copilot provider sanitation, and validate every consuming runner.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans both the managed invalid-reasoning retry and the shared Responses stream completion behavior.
